theorem.claim: z is a certified 1-L3-backdoor for every such fixed-pair state.
proof: After fixing the selected a_i and b_j, every other A vertex has no undecided neighbor except z; every other B vertex has no undecided neighbor except z.
Fix any kappa in the current list of z and propagate exactly.
Deleting/fixing z leaves all remaining A/B residual vertices mutually nonadjacent, hence every surviving undecided component is a singleton.
Each singleton current list has size at most 3: it began as a 3-list and exact propagation only removes colors.
Therefore every surviving singleton component has at least one color in [4] absent from its whole list union.
If propagation empties a list, that branch is an immediate contradiction terminal.
Thus every kappa branch lands in contradiction or the authorized P7-free List-3 terminal.
